description: This file declares the 'RequestCallbackNoPython' class, which implements a request callback mechanism for distributed RPC in PyTorch without Python dependencies. It defines method signatures for processing messages, handling RPC commands, and managing RRef (Remote Reference) operations within the distributed RPC framework.

classes.name: RequestCallbackNoPython
classes.description: Implementation of a request callback class that processes RPC messages without relying on Python dependencies, extending the base 'RequestCallback' class.
